topic: Booking the Freight Elevator for Moving Day

script.title: HOLD THE BUTTON, NOT THE DOOR
script.scene_zh: 大樓大廳櫃台 · 預約貨運電梯
script.story_hook: Moving day needs the freight elevator's blessing.
script.intro_zh: 搬家那天，得先得到貨運電梯的許可。
script.welcome_en: Hi, today a mover meets a building manager. Listen for booking rules and deposits.
script.welcome_zh: 嗨，今天要搬家的住戶遇到了大樓經理。留意預約規則與押金的說法。
script.outro: That's a move booked without a single fine. Listen again and keep the phrases.
script.outro_zh: 一場沒有罰單的搬家預約就這樣完成。再聽一遍，把好用的句子存起來。
script.practice_intro_en: Let's repeat the lines, one careful ride at a time.
script.practice_intro_zh: 我們來逐句跟讀，穩穩地，一次一句。
script.title_quote: The plant is older than me
script.char_a_description: a young man in his early twenties with short spiky hair dyed blue on top, a thick silver chain necklace, a black moving-company t-shirt with orange stripes, work gloves tucked in his back pocket, and a muscular build
script.char_b_description: a composed woman in her late fifties with a short gray bob haircut, rectangular glasses, a plum-colored cardigan over a white blouse, a gold name badge, and a slender build

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Hi, I'm moving into five C tomorrow morning.
dialogue.phonetic: /haɪ aɪm ˈmuːvɪŋ ˈɪntə faɪv si təˈmɑːroʊ ˈmɔːɹnɪŋ/
dialogue.zh: 嗨，我明天早上要搬進五C。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome! I'm Gloria, the building manager, hello.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm aɪm ˈɡlɔɹiə ðə ˈbɪldɪŋ ˈmænɪdʒəɚ həˈloʊ/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎！我是Gloria，這棟大樓的經理。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Nice to meet you. About the elevator, actually.
dialogue.phonetic: /naɪs tə miːt jə əˈbaʊt ði ˈɛləˌveɾɚ ˈæktʃuəli/
dialogue.zh: 很高興認識你。其實是電梯的事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ah, the freight elevator. Let's book it, then.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɑ ðə fɹeɪt ˈɛləˌveɾɚ lɛts bʊk ɪt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 啊，貨運電梯。那我們來預約。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Yes please. How do I even reserve that?
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs pliz haʊ du aɪ ˈivən ɹɪˈzɝɪv ðæt/
dialogue.zh: 拜託了。請問那個要怎麼訂？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Simple: time slot, deposit, and you sign the rules.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɪmpəl taɪm slɑt dɪˈpɑzɪt ænd ju saɪn ðə ɹulz/
dialogue.zh: 很簡單：時段、押金，再簽規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Okay, um, what time slots are still open?
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊkeɪ ʌm wɑt taɪm slɑts ɑɹ stɪl ˈoʊpən/
dialogue.zh: 好，嗯，還有哪些時段是空的？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow I have eight to ten, or two to four.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑːroʊ aɪ hæv eɪt tə tɛn ɔɹ tu tə fɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 明天我剩下八到十點，還有兩點到四點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight to ten is perfect, trucks love mornings.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt tə tɛn ɪz ˈpɝːfɛkt tɹʌks lʌv ˈmɔːɹnɪŋz/
dialogue.zh: 八到十點剛好，卡車喜歡早晨。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Careful, the truck can't idle in the driveway.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈkɛɹfəl ðə tɹʌk kænt ˈaɪdəl ɪn ðə ˈdɹaɪvˌweɪ/
dialogue.zh: 小心，卡車不能停在車道上怠速。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Got it, no idling. What's the deposit?
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡɑɾ ɪt noʊ ˈaɪdlɪŋ wʌts ðə dɪˈpɑzɪt/
dialogue.zh: 記下了，不怠速。押金是多少？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Two hundred, back to you if nothing breaks.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈhʌndɹəd bæk tə ju ɪf ˈnʌθɪŋ bɹeɪks/
dialogue.zh: 兩百，沒弄壞東西就全額退你。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Fair enough. What usually breaks, honestly?
dialogue.phonetic: /fɛɹ ɪˈnʌf wʌt ˈjuʒəwəli bɹeɪks ˈɑnəstli/
dialogue.zh: 合理。老實說，通常會弄壞什麼？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Well, mirrors mostly, and the brass door edges.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɛl ˈmɪɹəz ˈmoʊstli ænd ðə bɹæs dɔɹ ˈɛdʒəz/
dialogue.zh: 嗯，多半是鏡子，還有門邊的銅條。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We'll pad everything, my guys bring blankets.
dialogue.phonetic: /wil pæd ˈɛvɹiθɪŋ maɪ ɡaɪz bɹɪŋ ˈblæŋkɪts/
dialogue.zh: 我們會包墊子，夥伴也會帶毯子。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good, though the elevator pads are mine to lend.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd ðoʊ ði ˈɛləˌveɾɚ pædz ɑɹ maɪn tə lɛnd/
dialogue.zh: 很好，不過電梯的護墊得跟我借。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: You lend pads? Okay, how much for those?
dialogue.phonetic: /ju lɛnd pædz oʊkeɪ haʊ mʌtʃ fɚ ðoʊz/
dialogue.zh: 你們借護墊？好，那些多少錢？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Free, but they must return to this closet.
dialogue.phonetic: /fɹi bʌt ðeɪ mʌst ɹɪˈtɜɹn tə ðɪs ˈklɑzət/
dialogue.zh: 免費，但一定要歸還到這個儲藏室。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Deal. Um, my truck is twenty-six feet.
dialogue.phonetic: /dil ʌm maɪ tɹʌk ɪz ˈtwɛnti sɪks fit/
dialogue.zh: 說定。嗯，我的卡車有二十六呎。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Long! But your boxes will fit, barely.
dialogue.phonetic: /lɔŋ bʌt jɔɹ ˈbɑksəz wɪl fɪt ˈbɛɹli/
dialogue.zh: 很長！不過你的箱子進得去，剛剛好。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Barely is my favorite word this week already.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈbɛɹli ɪz maɪ ˈfeɪvəɹɪt wɚd ðɪs wik ɔlˈrɛdi/
dialogue.zh: 「剛剛好」已經是這週我最愛的詞了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha, then I'll say snug, it's kinder.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ ðɛn aɪl seɪ snʌɡ ɪts ˈkaɪndəɚ/
dialogue.zh: 哈，那我換個說法：剛剛卡得進去，比較動聽。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Snug. Yes, that's what I'll tell my crew.
dialogue.phonetic: /snʌɡ jɛs ðæts wʌt aɪl tɛl maɪ kɹu/
dialogue.zh: 「卡得進去」，好，我就這樣跟夥伴說。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Now the big rule: no propping the doors.
dialogue.phonetic: /naʊ ðə bɪɡ ɹul noʊ ˈpɹɑpɪŋ ðə dɔɹz/
dialogue.zh: 現在講大規則：不可以撐住電梯門。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Wait, what? How do we carry couches then?
dialogue.phonetic: /weɪt wʌt haʊ du wi ˈkæɹi ˈkaʊtʃəz ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 等等，什麼？那沙發怎麼搬？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You hold the button, never the door itself.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju hoʊld ðə ˈbʌtn ˈnɛvəɚ ðə dɔɹ ɪtˈsɛlf/
dialogue.zh: 要按住開門鍵，不可以擋門本身。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ohh, that's a difference that matters at eight a.m.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ ðæts ə ˈdɪfəɹəns ðæt ˈmæɾɐz æt eɪt ˌeɪˈɛm/
dialogue.zh: 噢，這個差別在早上八點就很重要了。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Exactly, the sensor fines two fifty per prop.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɪɡˈzæktli ðə ˈsɛnsəɚ faɪnz tu ˈfɪfti pɚ pɹɑp/
dialogue.zh: 沒錯，感應器擋門一次就罰兩百五。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Two fifty? Wow. Okay, button, not door.
dialogue.phonetic: /tu ˈfɪfti waʊ oʊkeɪ ˈbʌtn nɑt dɔɹ/
dialogue.zh: 兩百五？哇。好，按鍵，不擋門。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You're learning fast, most movers argue with me.
dialogue.phonetic: /jʊɹ ˈlɚnɪŋ fæst moʊst ˈmuːvəɚz ˈɑɹɡju wɪð mi/
dialogue.zh: 你學得快，多數搬運員都愛跟我辯。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha, we argue about lunch, never fines.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ wi ˈɑɹɡju əˈbaʊt lʌntʃ ˈnɛvəɚ faɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 哈，我們只為午餐計較，不為罰單計較。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Smart. Now, the corridor on five is narrow.
dialogue.phonetic: /smɑɹt naʊ ðə ˈkɔɹəˌdɔɹ ɑn faɪv ɪz ˈnæɹoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。還有，五樓的走道很窄。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Narrow how? My couch is a hero, Gloria.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈnæɹoʊ haʊ maɪ kaʊtʃ ɪz ə ˈhɪɹoʊ ˈɡlɔɹiə/
dialogue.zh: 窄到什麼程度？我的沙發可是英雄，Gloria。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: A hero couch? It must turn at the plant.
dialogue.phonetic: /ə ˈhɪɹoʊ kaʊtʃ ɪt mʌst tɜɹn æt ðə plænt/
dialogue.zh: 英雄沙發？它在盆栽那邊要轉彎。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: The plant! Should we move the plant, then?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plænt ʃʊd wi muv ðə plænt ðɛn/
dialogue.zh: 盆栽！那我們要先把它搬開嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Yes, move it Thursday night, it hates moving day.
dialogue.phonetic: /jɛs muv ɪt ˈθɜɹzˌdeɪ naɪt ɪt heɪts ˈmuːvɪŋ deɪ/
dialogue.zh: 對，週四晚上搬開它，它討厭搬家日。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Plants have schedules? This building is rich.
dialogue.phonetic: /plænts hæv ˈskædʒəlz ðɪs ˈbɪldɪŋ ɪz ɹɪtʃ/
dialogue.zh: 盆栽有行程表？這棟大樓真講究。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: The plant is older than me, be nice to it.
dialogue.phonetic: /ðə plænt ɪz ˈoʊldəɚ ðæn mi bi naɪs tə ɪt/
dialogue.zh: 那盆植物比我年紀還大，請對它溫柔。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Understood, plant first, couch second, questions few.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˌʌndɚˈstʊd plænt fɚst kaʊtʃ ˈsɛkənd ˈkwɛstʃənz fju/
dialogue.zh: 了解，先搬盆栽，再過沙發，少問問題。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Ha! Here's the sign sheet, read out loud.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ hɪɹz ðə saɪn ʃit ɹid aʊt ˈlaʊd/
dialogue.zh: 哈！這是簽名表，請大聲讀一遍。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Read it? Um, okay... slots, pads, button rule.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɹid ɪt ʌm oʊkeɪ slɑts pædz ˈbʌtn ɹul/
dialogue.zh: 大聲讀？嗯，好……時段、護墊、按鍵規則。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: And the quiet hours: no carts before seven.
dialogue.phonetic: /ænd ðə ˈkwaɪət ɑʊɚz noʊ kɑɹts bɪˈfɔɹ ˈsɛvən/
dialogue.zh: 還有安寧時段：七點前不准推車。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Seven. Our crew wakes up at five, oops.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈsɛvən ɑʊəɹ kɹu weɪks ʌp æt faɪv ʊps/
dialogue.zh: 七點。我們夥伴五點就醒，糟糕。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Good. Now, one small twist, sorry about this.
dialogue.phonetic: /ɡʊd naʊ wʌn smɔl twɪst ˈsɑɹi əˈbaʊt ðɪs/
dialogue.zh: 很好。不過有個小轉折，先說抱歉。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Twist? For the eight-to-ten slot? Please say no.
dialogue.phonetic: /twɪst fɚ ði eɪt tə tɛn slɑt pliz seɪ noʊ/
dialogue.zh: 轉折？是八到十點那個時段？拜託別是壞事。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Mrs. Chen booked the same window an hour ago.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn bʊkt ðə seɪm ˈwɪndoʊ ən ˈaʊəɚ əˈɡoʊ/
dialogue.zh: 陳太太一小時前訂了同一個時段。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Oh no, a couch versus Mrs. Chen? She wins.
dialogue.phonetic: /oʊ noʊ ə kaʊtʃ vɚˈsʌs ˈmɪsɪz tʃɛn ʃi wɪnz/
dialogue.zh: 噢不，沙發對上陳太太？她贏。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Clever man. But we can split it clean.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈklɛvəɹ mæn bʌt wi kæn splɪt ɪt klin/
dialogue.zh: 聰明。不過我們可以把它切開。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Split? How do we split a two-hour slot?
dialogue.phonetic: /splɪt haʊ du wi splɪt ə tu ˈaʊəɹ slɑt/
dialogue.zh: 切開？兩個小時的時段怎麼切？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: You take eight to nine, she takes nine to ten.
dialogue.phonetic: /ju teɪk eɪt tə naɪn ʃi teɪks naɪn tə tɛn/
dialogue.zh: 你拿八到九點，她拿九到十點。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Half each? Um, fine, half each is workable.
dialogue.phonetic: /hæf itʃ ʌm faɪn hæf itʃ ɪz ˈwɚkəbəbl/
dialogue.zh: 一半一半？嗯，好，這樣可行。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Workable with a practiced cart team, yes.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɚkəbəbl wɪð ə ˈpɹæktəst kɑɹt tim jɛs/
dialogue.zh: 推車練過的隊伍才行，你們是嗎？

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: We're that team. Eight to nine is ours.
dialogue.phonetic: /wɪɹ ðæt tim eɪt tə naɪn ɪz ˈaʊəɚz/
dialogue.zh: 我們正是那支隊伍。八到九點歸我們。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Signed! Here's your key card and the pad set.
dialogue.phonetic: /saɪnd hɪɹz jɔɹ ki kɑɹd ænd ðə pæd sɛt/
dialogue.zh: 簽好了！這是你的門禁卡和整套護墊。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: That was painless. Anything else, Captain Elevator?
dialogue.phonetic: /ðæt wəz ˈpeɪnləs ˈɛniˌθɪŋ ɛls ˈkæpɪtən ˈɛləˌveɾɚ/
dialogue.zh: 一點都不痛苦。還有別的事嗎，電梯大隊長？

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: One gift: the plant says thank-you notes are policy.
dialogue.phonetic: /wʌn ɡɪft ðə plænt sɛz ˈθæŋkˌju noʊts ɑɹ ˈpɑləsi/
dialogue.zh: 再送你一個情報：盆栽說，感謝卡是這裡的規定。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Ha! I'll write one tonight, right after lunch.
dialogue.phonetic: /hɑ aɪl ɹaɪt wʌn təˈnaɪt ɹaɪt ˈæftəɚ lʌntʃ/
dialogue.zh: 哈！我今晚就寫，吃完午餐就寫。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Tomorrow, eight sharp. The lobby will be yours.
dialogue.phonetic: /təˈmɑːroʊ eɪt ʃɑɹp ðə ˈlɑbi wɪl bi jɔɹz/
dialogue.zh: 明天，八點整。大廳就是你們的了。

dialogue.speaker: char_a
dialogue.text: Eight sharp, snug truck, happy plant. See you.
dialogue.phonetic: /eɪt ʃɑɹp snʌɡ tɹʌk ˈhæpi plænt si ju/
dialogue.zh: 八點整，剛好的卡車，開心的盆栽。再見。

dialogue.speaker: char_b
dialogue.text: Welcome to five C, mover. Mind the brass.
dialogue.phonetic: /ˈwɛlkəm tə faɪv si ˈmuːvəɚ maɪnd ðə bɹæs/
dialogue.zh: 歡迎搬到五C，搬運大師。小心銅邊。

script.youtube_title: 【搬家預約貨梯🛗】「那盆植物比我年紀還大」跟大樓經理的攻防📦🎧｜押金・護墊・罰單一次聽懂｜60句沉浸式英語聽力｜Booking the Freight Elevator
script.youtube_title_en: "The Plant Is Older Than Me" — Booking the Freight Elevator for Moving Day
script.youtube_description:
「那盆植物比我年紀還大」——搬家那天要預約貨運電梯，用英文會遇到哪些規則與笑點？這一集是 60 句沉浸式英語聽力練習，場景就在大樓大廳的櫃台。

你會聽到：預約電梯的開場問法；時段、押金、護墊借用歸還的完整說法；不能擋門、不能在車道怠速的規矩與罰單；時段讓別人先訂走時，怎麼禮貌地把兩小時切開用；還有跟盆栽、沙發、陳太太有關的真實搬家小事。

整段對話只用 A2 初級單字與短句，反覆出現美國人辦事的自然語感：um、well、ha、wow。聽完你就會用：time slot、back to you if nothing breaks、Let's book it、Mind the brass。

後半段是逐句聽力＋跟讀練習，請大聲跟著唸，讓舌頭先記住，腦袋自然就跟上。

不用背，多聽就會用。每天一集，把英文聽成直覺。

#EnglishListening #ESL #LearnEnglish｜喜歡的話請按訂閱與小鈴鐺。
script.youtube_description_en:
"The plant is older than me" — what happens when you book a freight elevator on moving day? This is a 60-line immersive English listening practice set at the front desk of an apartment building.

You will hear: opening a booking request, asking which time slots are open, deposits and what they cover, borrowing elevator pads and where they return, the golden rule of holding the button instead of the door, fines, quiet hours, and a same-slot clash with another resident solved by splitting the window.

Everything stays in A2-level words with natural American texture: um, well, ha, wow. By the end you'll own phrases like time slot, back to you if nothing breaks, and Mind the brass.

The final chapter is a line-by-line listen-and-repeat workout, so speak out loud and let your mouth learn first.

No memorizing needed — just listen often and it sticks.

📌 影片簡介：
明天一早要搬家，貨運電梯還沒預約，該去櫃台問什麼？押金多少、護墊跟誰借、時段卻讓別人先訂走了怎麼辦？

這一集帶大家走進大樓大廳的櫃台，聽搬運員跟大樓經理從預約時段一路聊到盆栽外交，共 60 句連續真實對話。

✂️ 時段衝突：Oh no, a couch versus Mrs. Chen? She wins.
